title: Improving Today, Narrowing Tomorrow: Collective Learning, Diversity, and Generativity
abstract: arXiv:2609.28681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI makes a paradox newly visible: learning from a common source can improve what each firm does today while narrowing the variety available for tomorrow's discoveries. The tension extends beyond AI. Fields turn recurring features of successful organizations into portable practices, such as just-in-time production, freemium business models, or mixture-of-experts architectures. These collective abstractions are partial templates others can adapt, not designs or universal prescriptions. We study how they shape discovery in a model of firms searching interdependent landscapes. A collective repertoire extracts practices from patterns shared by leading configurations; firms vary in how they evaluate those practices locally. The model reveals a generativity chain: population diversity supplies heterogeneous experience, collective abstraction turns it into reusable options, and situated judgment matches options to local needs. translated_title: 改善今天，收窄明天：集体学习、多样性与生成性
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能让一个悖论变得格外显眼：从同一来源学习能够改善每个企业今天的表现，却收窄了可供明天发现所利用的多样性。这种张力并不局限于人工智能领域。各个领域都会把成功组织反复出现的特征转化为可移植的实践，例如准时制生产、免费增值商业模式或混合专家架构。这些集体抽象是他人可以借鉴改编的部分模板，而非完整设计或普适处方。我们在一个企业搜索相互依赖适应度地形的模型中研究这些集体抽象如何塑造发现过程。集体剧目库从领先配置所共享的模式中提取实践；各企业在如何因地制宜地评估这些实践上存在差异。该模型揭示了一条生成性链条：群体多样性提供异质经验，集体抽象将其转化为可复用的选项，而情境化判断则将选项与局部需求相匹配。
tldr: 该论文通过企业搜索相互依赖地形的模型提出“生成性链条”——群体多样性提供异质经验、集体抽象将其转化为可复用实践、情境化判断将实践匹配到局部需求——并警示从共同来源学习虽能改善当下的表现，却会收窄未来发现所需的多样性。
en_tdlr: Using a model of firms searching interdependent landscapes, this paper reveals a "generativity chain"—population diversity supplies heterogeneous experience, collective abstraction turns it into reusable practices, and situated judgment matches them to local needs—while warning that learning from a common source improves today's performance but narrows the variety needed for tomorrow's discoveries.
